## 1. Executive Summary

The sample masquerades as a legitimate 'DWAgent service' per its version information (source: Malcat file_summary.metadata, VersionInfo::FileDescription = 'DWAgent service'). Static analysis confirms multiple hostile behavioral capabilities: Windows service persistence, registry Run key persistence, shortcut-based persistence, embedded command-and-control (C2) indicators, and layered obfuscation to evade detection. No evidence of active defense impairment (e.g., antivirus disabling, security log deletion) was observed across analyzed artifacts. All behavioral signals are corroborated across independent analysis engines (capa, YARA, pe_imports, Malcat), eliminating false positive risk from single-engine anomalies.
